ledger.note: 1011: Sunyer of Pallars dies and the county is divided; Raymond III takes Pallars Jussà. 'In 1011, Sunyer of Pallars died and by his testament his county was divided between his sons'; the Pallars page: 'Sunyer's two sons divided their inheritance, with Raymond III ruling in Pallars Jussà and William II in Pallars Sobirà.'
1192 (27 May): the heiress Dulce de So gives Pallars Jussà to the Crown of Aragon. 'On 27 May 1192, she donated the county to Alfonso and the Crown of Aragon.'
1192 (27 May): the county ends as a separate state and is absorbed by the Crown of Aragon; the last count line (Raymond III to Dulce de So) is extinct.

wars.name: Bernard Raymond's campaign against Lleida
wars.outcome: Bernard Raymond 'had fought with Raymond Berengar III of Barcelona against Lleida'; the page dates it by his reign (1112–1124) and states no territorial result.
wars.note: Years are the reign of Bernard Raymond; the page does not date the campaign. The county page's frontier is 'the Moorish Conca de Tremp and Montsec'.

certainty.note: Pyrenean valley county: the pages name valleys and a Moorish frontier ('Conca de Tremp and Montsec'), not lines; the northern boundary with Pallars Sobirà is the best-defined.

notes: (1) Cliopatria's County of Pallars row (875-1014) ends before the Jussà row starts (1040); the 1015-1039 gap is covered by the new 1011 keyframe. (2) The county page has no infobox; years of the counts are from its list (Valença appears twice, as a bride in 1055 and as a countess 1177-1182). (3) The page's 'frontier with the Moorish Conca de Tremp and Montsec' and the Lleida campaign are the only Muslim-frontier statements; no gain or loss of land is dated (the Cliopatria shape change of 1111 is unexplained). (4) The first fetch, 'Pallars_Jussà', returned the modern comarca; the county is at 'County_of_Pallars_Jussà'. (5) Cliopatria's neighbours list shows Almoravid dynasty 1111-1151 touching the county; no page opened says so. (6) The Lérida taifa (Lleida) has no dossier; the Lleida war uses the slug taifa-of-lerida.
